verdict.rationale: Exa's pricing docs list per-request rates publicly: Deep Search at $12–15 per 1k requests, Answer at $5 per 1k, and extra content pages at $1 per 1,000 beyond 10 per search. Billing is self-serve pay-as-you-go with no subscription or minimum, a free tier that needs no payment method, and in-dashboard credit loading, so no sales contact is needed. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of the pricing experience, and no explicit per-unit rates in the evidence for the usage-based Exa Agent and Websets products.
